_doc: INV-15: files that hold or may hold secrets. policy_guard.py blocks reading, grepping, copying, sourcing or staging them through any tool; settings.json deny rules are the first layer. basename_globs/basename_exceptions use fnmatch on the file name; home_paths are relative to $HOME (the session user's home, /root in cloud); absolute_globs use fnmatch on the absolute path (symlinks are resolved and both forms are checked).
